actors.name: Aldergate Rail (the firm)
actors.private_context: Aldergate Rail is aware of a delay in a signaling contract that could materially affect its financial position. It has a scheduled interim results day on November 5. The firm's leadership must decide whether to issue a market warning before that date, considering regulatory obligations and market expectations.

shared_context: Aldergate Rail is a listed firm. There is a signaling-contract delay that may be material. The firm has an interim results day scheduled for November 5. Market warning regulations require timely disclosure of material information.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. Aldergate Rail is aware of the signaling-contract delay and must decide whether to warn the market before the interim results day.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Aldergate Rail issued a market warning about the signaling-contract delay before 2026-11-05T07:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
